blocks.title: Explain the important decision
blocks.text: An int parameter normally receives a copied number. A Box parameter normally receives a copied reference to the same object. ref instead aliases the caller variable, allowing that variable to be reassigned.

blocks.title: Worked example · Compare changes to a copy and an object
blocks.text: Trace these calls from fresh state: int x=5; CopyInt(x); Box item=new Box { Value=5 }; Box alias=item; Mutate(item); Replace(ref item);

blocks.title: Worked example · Copy an integer value
blocks.text: Start x=5; CopyInt(x) changes only local n to 9. The caller x remains 5. This is pass-by-value.

blocks.title: Worked example · Copy a reference; mutate one object
blocks.text: Start item→Box A(Value=5), alias=item. Mutate(item) copies the reference, then changes Box A.Value to 9. Both item and alias still refer to Box A.
